depiction.primary_object: horizontal line with arrowheads at both ends

readings.meaning: swap, exchange, or trade between two things
compare two options side by side

ambiguity: Often read as a UI resize-width cursor rather than a real-world object or distinct action; easily confused with dedicated two-arrow swap/exchange icons.
task_intents: exchange wrong size item at store
measure width of doorway or alcove

Measure the clear width of the basement stairs to see if the dryer fits

reasoning: A plain horizontal double-headed arrow is primarily an interface glyph for resizing width or panning rather than a concrete task subject. While it can loosely suggest swapping, comparing, or measuring width, tasks about those concepts almost always have a concrete object (a shirt, a doorway, money, a shift) that deserves its own icon.
